title: Change of Service Model under the Workplace Cafe Management Program
content:
A client may move an existing cafe from one service model to another without closing the cafe management contract, provided the site meets the entry gate of the model it is moving to. This is the governing condition for the change and is read from the site's own record before the change is handled.

**Condition on the contract standing.** The change is handled only where the contract stands active or suspended. It is not handled on a contract in any other standing. Eligibility is checked against the specific cafe contract named in the request, using that contract's own status, its own current service model, and its own reported headcount as held on file — not a description the client gives of the site's standing.

**Condition on the direction of the move.** A move to a lower ranked service model is only accepted once the cooldown printed against the model currently in force has passed since the last change of service model made on this contract. This condition remains in force.

**Timing and administration fee on the change — no longer in force.** The contract formerly stated that the change took effect no sooner than the change notice printed against the service model being left, counted in calendar days from the day the client asked for the change, and that the administration fee printed against the model being moved to was invoiced in the period the change took effect. That clause is no longer in force, superseded by the current basis; the change notice period and administration fee printed against a service model remain figures of record and are not restated here as numbers.

**Cooldown and opening project fee on an upgrade — no longer in force.** The contract formerly stated that a move to a higher ranked service model carried no cooldown, but that the opening project fee difference between the two models was invoiced alongside the administration fee where the higher model needed kitchen works. That clause is no longer in force, superseded by the current basis.

**Effect of the change once made.** From the effective day, the whole parameter column of the new service model applies together — fee, subsidy model, daily ceiling, notice periods, credits and guarantees together — and no parameter of the old service model survives the change. This treatment remains in force.

**Where the entry gate is not met.** Where the site does not meet the entry gate of the model asked for, the change is declined, and the highest service model whose entry gate the site does meet is offered instead. This treatment remains in force.

**Parameters printed per service model.** Each of the six service models of the Workplace Cafe Management Program prints its own change notice period, in calendar days; its own downgrade cooldown, in months, measured from the last change of service model on the contract; and its own administration fee charged for a change of service model. No single figure is shared across all six service models for any of these.

superseded_clauses: The change takes effect no sooner than the change notice printed against the service model being left, counted in calendar days from the day the client asks for the change, and the administration fee printed against the model being moved to is invoiced in the period the change takes effect.

A move to a higher ranked service model carries no cooldown, but the opening project fee difference between the two models is invoiced alongside the administration fee where the higher model needs kitchen works.
